buttons.title: My Career Journey

description.desc: Serving as Technical Architect managing an in-house ASP.NET MVC deployment platform for a major European automotive manufacturer. Engineered direct API/SDK integrations with Matrix42 Enterprise Manager and SCCM inside Visual Studio Enterprise, enabling real-time application deployment tasks that trigger immediate endpoint agent installations—bypassing traditional SCCM/Intune polling delays while managing full-stack C# backend logic, database operations, and frontend UI.

Served as Technical Lead across enterprise accounts managing 100,000+ endpoints. Oversaw SCCM packaging, WinPE/HTA pre-PXE customization, Zero-Touch OS Deployments (ZTI), and Matrix42 Enterprise Server Manager optimization. Engineered full-stack internal platform tools using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, and PowerShell WPF GUIs, backed by optimized T-SQL database queries. Led agile workflows in Jira/Git, authored architecture in Confluence, and mentored cross-disciplinary teams.

Managed and optimized an entire SCCM 2012 R2 environment—including boundaries, site maintenance, CAS/Primary/Secondary server monitoring, distribution point management, and client health checks. Built LTI/ZTI Task Sequences, complex Windows 10 upgrade packages, USMT solutions, and compliance baselines. Executed Windows 10 Servicing and Office 365 client management via ADRs, while administering multi-domain Group Policies, isolated WSUS servers, and VMware/vSphere environments. Modernized software packaging with PSADT, built custom C#.NET WPF tools, and authored SSRS reports.

Served as Technical Lead supporting software distribution infrastructure, OS image deployment, and patch management across SMS 2003, SCCM 2007/2012/2012 R2, and Altiris 7.5/7.6/8.1 environments. Created captured images using Altiris Image Deployment (Symantec Ghost), optimized Group Policies and logon/startup scripts, and configured OU structures for deployment strategies. Engineered object-oriented .NET GUI applications and framework automation tools for internal and customer use, developed complex SQL queries in SSMS for reporting, and led technical client consultations.

Served as Technical Lead for Software Distribution managing multi-customer infrastructure, OS image deployment, and troubleshooting across SMS 2003, SCCM, and Altiris environments. Engineered custom capture images via Altiris, directed WSUS/SCCM patch management, and optimized GPO architecture by establishing targeted OU structures and tuning WMI queries. Modernized logon/startup scripts using VBScript and Batch to cut boot times, developed .NET GUI applications for customer frameworks, and delivered technical team trainings.

Elevated to Senior L2 Technical Lead at HP, steering support operations for key enterprise accounts including Monier and Panasonic. Specialized in deciphering systemic infrastructure issues from minimal diagnostics, handling complex escalations, and mentoring cross-functional team members.

Delivered multilingual L1/L2 technical support in German, English, and Dutch across major global client accounts, including Sybase, Innospec, Nalco, and Honeywell. Supported internal service desk operations and colleagues, managing ticket resolution and technical troubleshooting across enterprise environments.
Provided dedicated German-language Service Desk support for T-Systems Germany, handling user support, incident logging, ticket management, and initial technical triage.

dropdownItems.title: StartUp / LogonScript Handler Framework
dropdownItems.description:
Active Directory Group Targeting

Implemented dynamic membership checking that cross-references the client computer's AD groups against script filenames (omitting extension) to conditionally run targeted scripts only for authorized endpoints

Standardized Logging Template

Enforced a uniform script template across all modules, automatically writing local client log files to streamline troubleshooting during execution failures.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

Integrated a centralized execution log that calculates individual script runtimes and outputs total elapsed time per session to benchmark and optimize overall user logon duration.

dropdownItems.title: SCCM & Matrix42 Infrastructure Health Tester
dropdownItems.description: An automated PowerShell diagnostic tool scheduled for daily morning execution to evaluate core endpoint infrastructure health. It performs automated WMI connectivity verification between managed servers and the SCCM environment, while simultaneously scanning Matrix42 Enterprise Manager event logs for operational errors. Upon detecting system anomalies, the framework automatically triggers alerts to the central enterprise monitoring platform and initiates automated IT Service Management ticket creation for immediate engineering remediation.

dropdownItems.title: PC Information Tool (v1.01)
dropdownItems.description:
Distributed to enterprise endpoint devices to empower end-users with instant self-service system visibility. Aggregates critical General, Hardware, and Network parameters (IP, MAC, Serial, OS version) into a clear interface.

Features a prominent 'Copy Information to clipboard' action to eliminate ticket back-and-forth by letting users instantly paste diagnostics into support requests. Includes built-in Quick-Fix, Software inventory, and Diagnostic tabs for automated issue remediation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/pc-info-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Ultimate Active Directory Search Tool (UADST)
dropdownItems.description:
Streamlined administrative utility designed as a lightweight alternative to native Active Directory Users and Computers (ADUC). Enables rapid object discovery across Users, Computers, and Groups within the domain.

Features customizable 'Column Select' controls to extract only relevant AD attributes (e.g., operatingSystem, lastLogonTimestamp), secondary filtering options, and group membership lookups. Includes one-click output export and clipboard copying complete with headers for easy documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-query-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: IT - Ping & Remote Action Tool
dropdownItems.description:
Multi-threaded reachability and remote administration utility for helpdesk and sysadmins. Allows bulk monitoring of computer lists, resolving real-time IP addresses, Online/Offline status, and FQDNs.

Selecting any target host automatically populates the quick-action panel to execute instant remote administration tasks: pull detailed system info via WMI ('Get Info'), open the administrative share ('Open C$'), or spawn a remote PowerShell session ('PSSession').

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ping-tool.html

dropdownItems.title: Active Directory Security Group Updater
dropdownItems.description:
Bulk administration utility built to perform safe, high-speed Active Directory security group membership updates. Enables administrators to add or remove multiple target user/computer objects across multiple groups simultaneously in a single execution pass.

Includes a dedicated real-time Error Handling & Reporting Grid that tracks individual operation statuses (e.g., User Added, User Not Found, Already a Member). Provides immediate visual confirmation and instant audit feedback for ticket documentation.

Documentation: https://peskyjim.blogspot.com/p/ad-security-group-updater.html

dropdownItems.title: Enterprise Client Support Utility
dropdownItems.description:
A feature-rich PowerShell WPF GUI engineered to streamline single-endpoint administration, remote diagnostics, and automated infrastructure repairs.

  • Automated Diagnostics: Real-time status checks for WMI, C$ share access, DNS conflicts, and disk space.
  • 1-Click Remediation: Built-in repair actions for WMI repository, SCCM Client agent, and Windows Update Agent.
  • Remote Administration: Direct shortcuts for CMD, elevated System sessions, and interactive PSSessions.
  • Live Telemetry: Synchronous execution log console alongside structured status tables.

buttons.title: About This Site
buttons.description:
Architecture & Data Flow

Built with a lightweight, data-driven architecture that completely separates layout from content. All site metadata, navigation buttons, and tool project entries are stored externally in a structured data.json file.

Frontend & Styling

Engineered using HTML5 and Tailwind CSS v4 for a responsive layout. Utilizes utility-first CSS components to maintain consistent typography, button states, and hover effects across desktop and mobile devices.

Dynamic Rendering

Powered by a custom vanilla JavaScript engine (app.js) that fetches data.json asynchronously on page load to dynamically render interface elements, populate project details, and build interactive dropdown context menus.

AI Assistance & Development

Designed and refactored with the help of AI assistance (Gemini) to accelerate code iteration, optimize Tailwind CSS utility layouts, refine dynamic JSON parsing, and polish responsive UI styling.

Hosting & Deployment

Zero-framework overhead delivering instant page loads. Version-controlled on GitHub and deployed via GitHub Pages with custom domain integration (jjim.dev).
